title: Activists say Israel tries to expel a whole Palestinian neighborhood in East Jerusalem
key_takeaways: The recent escalation in demolition orders has sparked concerns among Palestinians and activists, who claim that Israel is attempting to expel a whole Palestinian neighborhood in East Jerusalem.

The orders are often based on claims that the homes were built without the necessary permits, although many Palestinians argue that it is impossible to obtain such permits due to discriminatory zoning laws.
The international community must condemn Israel's actions and work to protect the rights of Palestinian residents, including their right to housing and self-determination.
